content.text:
October 2024 had the most Seattle building permit applications, with 619 submitted.

I used the City of Seattle building permits dataset and counted permits by the date the city accepted the application as complete (the "AppliedDate" field). Every permit type in the dataset is included, such as building, demolition and roofing.

| Month | Applications |
|---|---|
| **2024-10** | **619** |
| 2024-03 | 552 |
| 2024-04 | 526 |
| 2024-05 | 516 |
| 2024-07 | 513 |
| 2024-09 | 504 |
| 2024-11 | 501 |
| 2024-08 | 489 |
| 2024-01 | 470 |
| 2024-12 | 462 |
| 2024-06 | 458 |
| 2024-02 | 454 |

About 46,000 permits in the dataset have no application date, so they aren't counted.

FINAL ANSWER: 2024-10
